debrief.summary: Operation 2 ended: 6 Russian soldiers carried, 0 wounded/recovering, readiness 0.81, banked ammo 255, build 309, food 187, med 119, lost/spent ammo 165, build 111, food 33, med 21.
recommendations: Keep the balanced stockpile and build from the right-side Russian camp toward one lane at a time.
Use the debrief to name one soldier to protect, then set priorities before ordering the next trench.
Stock the connected trench network with a closer ammo box before the next push.
Add wire to the likely Ukrainian approach, but leave one retreat mouth clear.
Send a small expedition before the next breach so the route can create warnings before casualties.
Prepare demolition and hit a Ukrainian weak point; passive camp damage is not the main win path.
Position held because dugout rallied defenders into connected trenches.
